Dialog: Meap.

Dialog: If you haven't seen the first two, go back and watch them now. We will wait. (Meap pulls out a watch and gives a couple seconds.) Okay we're done waiting.

Dialog: The first episode of Meap ended with a trailer of random shots for an episode we never intended to make. But then, we had to write around those shots, incorporating them into a second episode. At which point, we knew we weren't going to make a third episode, so we ended it with an even dumber trailer. Take a look.

Dialog: And now, a trailer for an episode we also have no plans to make.

Dialog: Pay attention up there!

Dialog: Jerry the Platypus?

Dialog: Ferb, aren't those extinct?

Dialog: As a matter of fact, I object to this union.

Dialog: The Chronicles of Meap, Episode 42.

Dialog: Meap!

Dialog: "Meap Me in St. Louis".

Dialog: Wasn't that Suzy stuff supposed to be in this one?

Dialog: (cont'd) (And now, we're back to the opening of this episode. The 12 shots are displayed on a 4x3 grid.) Now, somehow, we have to incorporate these 12 shots into an episode. Here goes.

Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #1

Dialog: This is the Alliance Commander.

Dialog: You've been ordered to stand down.

Dialog: Self-destruct initiated.

Dialog: (gasps)' Oh, man. You know how much paperwork this means?

Dialog: The Chronicles of Meap, Episode 42...

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap.

Name: Narrator
Dialog: "Meap Me in St. Louis"! Starring John Stamos as Meap!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap. (into his communicator) Meap meap meap meap meap.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, Candace, you're at a Bango-Ru-themed birthday party for a little girl who despises you. I just hope no one objects to a giraffe marrying a lemur.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walking through stained-glass fence doors wearing a suit) Well, as a matter of fact, I object to this union.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #2

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: But only 'cause it's cuter than my shark-koala.

Name: Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro
Dialog: So your wife is still in her stained glass phase?

Name: Mr. Johnson
Dialog: (walking away) I don't wanna talk about it.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Thanks for coming, Candace. Suzy's been waiting for you all day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah. She looks pretty psyched. Hey, did I see Perry on the invite?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (laughing) No. She invited Jerry the Platypus.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #3

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jerry the Platypus?

Name: Candace
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #4

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: A little further. (opens gate) A little further. Okay, open your eyes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Eh? Eh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh, if dis is an intervention, I don't think you guys are doin' it right.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, today's the day! We're gonna build a Bread Bowl Hot Tub!

Name: Echo
Dialog: Bread Bowl Hot Tub...

Name: Buford
Dialog: YEAAAAAAAHHHHH!! WHOA! YEAH YEAH YEAH YEAH!!!! DREAMS DO COME TRUE!!! WOOHOO!!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that was trippy. Good morning, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted doing a variety of non-evil things, maniacally.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We have to assume evil intent, though, because that's what pays the bills around here. Thwart away, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Here we go! This doesn't even make any sense!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! I'm gonna be soakin' in soup!! WOOHOOOOOO!!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: VHS tapes? Ferb, aren't those extinct?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #5

Name: Candace
Dialog: So this is kinda cool. Just regular folks havin' a nice time. And Meap. Meap, what are you doing here?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Candace, I've come sixteen million lightyears to find you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, how can I understand you without your mustache translator?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Oh, we got new translators. (holds out his remote) That's why I sound like John Stamos. Have mercy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, of course.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Candace, Big Mitch is back with a new, convoluted, evil scheme, but no one believes me. And you are my only hope. Come on!

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Jeremy, Brayden #3 is dipping his finger into the cake and denying it! I wish I could bust him!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pssh! Child's play. I could bust him with my hands tied behind my back.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Well, if it's so easy, why don't you show me? Come on. (grabs Candace's hand)

Name: Meap
Dialog: (grabs Candace's other hand) We are on an important mission, young lady. Let us pass.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: I don't think so, short stuff. I think you and I are about to have a giant Matrix-like battle.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: In front of all these Bango-Ru toys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no, no, no. I'll do this.

Name: Suzy
Dialog: Oh, guess we're not gonna fight. Brayden, you are so busted!

Name: Meap
Dialog: That was amazing! Exactly why I sought you out. Candace, you are the most focused, determined busting machine I know. Together, we can bring Mitch down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (scoffs) Well, it is sorta my wheelhouse, so you know, sure, I'm in.

Name: Meap
Dialog: The first thing we must do is recruit the rest of our team. The most inventive human minds this side of Nebulous Nebula.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're gonna say, "Phineas and Ferb", aren't you?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Yes. Yes, I am.

Name: Buford
Dialog: YEAH! WOOHOO! YEAH!!!

Name: The gang
Dialog: (nonplussed) Oh, hi, Candace.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Meap! (fist bumps him)

Name: Meap
Dialog: We need your help with Big Mitch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Of course. Oh, sorry, Buford. We'll have to save the Bread Bowl Hot Tub for another day.

Name: Buford
Dialog: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #6

Name: Meap
Dialog: And to make matters worse, my own Alliance commandos are after me. I was forced to go rogue in order to prove Mitch is planning to build a vast criminal empire by finding the lost treasure of Zachariah Yore.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Who?

Name: Scroll
Dialog: In the times of Yore, there was an intrepid explorer named Zachariah Yore. Young Zachariah was born to AnnaBeth and Josiah Yore in the outskirts of the small farming settlement of FarmTown.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh, I don't care that much.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Well, the treasure's a huge case filled with enough treasure to buy an equally huge case filled with the same amount of treasure.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's a lot of treasure.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So where is Mitch anyway?

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Do you need a break from the tedious shame spiral that is your life? I can give it to you at Big Mitch's Ultimate Vacation Destination Tours.

Name: Meap
Dialog: These fake tours are a ruse to fund Mitch's search for an ancient treasure. A treasure that I believe is right here on Earth.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, we could set a trap and catch Mitch redhanded trying to steal it.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Great idea, Candace, but it could put the planet in grave danger. These tourists have trashed every environment they've gone to.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, we can handle a few partying out-of-towners. Right, Ferb?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The question is

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait! I know! Stabby Barf Pain!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Excuse me? Stabby Barf Pain sounds like the worst thing ever!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Stabby Barf Pain is the name of a theoretical fifth season that combines the best aspects of the other four seasons, winter, spring, summer, and fall into one! Flowers bloom as golden leaves fall from trees. Warm sun shines as beautiful snowflakes fill the air. A fifth season beyond all expectations!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's Stabby Barf Pain?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yep. It gets its name from the scientist who theorized it. Dr. Sunny Gloriousweather. Yeah, he was bad at naming things. It's theoretical, but what if we actually made it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, let's try this again. Eh, eh, eh. (He walks weirdly.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Look, Balloony's back. You remember Balloony, right? Why is laughing the only thing evil scientists do, you know, "maniacally"? I thought, hey, I should stand out and something else maniacally. I'm expanding my brand.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So far, not that much luck. Walking maniacally, that ain't happening. You saw. You saw. Neither is brushing my teeth maniacally.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Asking for a shoe in size ten, maniacally. Going to the bathroom, maniacally. That was... That was a failure of epic proportions. You don't wanna know.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, Perry the Platypus, where are you going? I... I could use a non-latex second opinion, I... Please? Please?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, see it's annoying, but it works!

Name: Alien 1
Dialog: This place stinks. This isn't vacation weather. It's raining crustaceans.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: It's time we continue our quest for the galaxy's...

Name: Mitch, Alien 1 and Alien 2
Dialog: Ultimate vacation destination.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: We need to find a real vacation destination before these losers see through my ruse and stop funding this expedition. Keep scanning!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Operation Snitch on Mitch.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: These weather altering machines will spread Stabby Barf Pain across Danville. Attracting anyone out there scanning for vacation destinations.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Candace and I will use my intel to locate the treasure. I just wish I had my ship.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You mean the Ride from Outer Space? Ferb?

Name: Meap
Dialog: My ship! B-But it was destroyed. You mean you made me another one?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (referring to Ferb) Nah, he made one for us because it was too cool not to have, but you can have it. We're done.

Name: Meap
Dialog: (grateful) Oh, thank you! (serious) I mean, thank you. (Meap pushes the button.) There. Locked and armed.

Name: Meap
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #7

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Oh, that's the self-destruct button. (pushes remote) The alarm is on the other side.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, maybe we made two. In case someone accidentally exploded it. I mean, the remote is ambiguous.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, i-i-if you're a fugitive from the Alliance, can't they track your remote signal here to Earth?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Yes. Yes, they can.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Um, if yer done starin' into the distance, we gotta lotta work to do.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Pay attention up there!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #8

Name: Hench-bot
Dialog: We've intercepted as signal from Earth.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Stabby Barf Pain? I thought that was theoretical! I have found the perfect vacation destination! Set a course for this... "Earth". (laughs maniacally)

Name: Aliens
Dialog: What do we want? The ultimate vacation destination! When do we want it? In the foreseeable future!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Just as I promised, the ultimate vacation destination with Stabby Barf Pain!

Name: Alien 3
Dialog: Stabby Barf Pain? The theoretical fifth season?

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (to Hench-Robot) Set course to Earth. (laughs maniacally) That should appease those insufferable ingrates.

Name: Alien 3
Dialog: We can still hear you!

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey, that's refreshing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Stabby Barf Pain? Just when we were sure we only had four seasons, suddenly there's a fifth. Anyway, we'll have to take the bus because maniacal parallel parking turned out pretty much as expected.

Name: Norm
Dialog: I made a dinner date with the jaws-of-life.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap, meap, meap...

Name: Meap
Dialog: We must hurry before the Alliance finds me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tracking the treasure case's trajectory, it ended up in Missouri sometime around 1933.

Name: Meap
Dialog: That case is supposed to be huge. How could they keep something like that hidden?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's see, in 1933, St. Louis created a monument to Western expansion in America. This thing.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Candace, that's it!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Hmmm, Stabby Barf Pain is spreading in this area. I'll send our obnoxious tourists down there while we continue our search for the treasure. Colin Jr. can head up the landing party. Speaking of which, where is Colin Ju— Ugh.

Name: Hench-Robot
Dialog: Sorry, sir. It happened again.

Name: Hench-Robot
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #9

Name: Mitch
Dialog: It really is Stabby Barf Pain! I can't believe—Wait, freeze that image.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: It's Colin! The real Colin! (to Colin Jr.) I don't need you anymore.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait. What is everybody... Oh, I get it. Alien invasion. Yeah, that's, that's worth staring at. I get it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Hey, wait, wait, wait, no! No, Balloony!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously? You had this the whole time? Why were we taking the bus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gets in the car) Oh, that's right. The trailer thing. Save Balloony!

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: Woohoo! Stabby Barf Pain makes me wanna par-tay!

Name: Baby alien
Dialog: It's pillaging weather, baby!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Dink Winkerson here as alien tourists trash Danville.

Name: Alien 5
Dialog: I love prepaid vacations!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're trashing everything!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've gotta find a way to wrangle these alien visitors. Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? It's pillaging weather.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Just remember, we've got to get to Mitch before the Alliance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (taking the remote) Uh-uh! Remember, it's the other button.

Name: Hench-Robot
Dialog: Intruder. Identify yourself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, come on, come on. You gotta see what the other bots are doing! C'mon! Hurry!

Name: Meap
Dialog: Nice work, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, that's Busting 101, I got this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Or maybe I don't.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Look who's here, Colin. My old nemesis, Meap. (to Candace) And, uh, what are you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm the girl who brought you down twice already.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Me? But I'm just a totally innocent and legitimate business owner who has already paid his debt to society.

Name: Meap
Dialog: "Totally innocent and legitimate business owner who's already paid his debt to society" my fuzzy white butt.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't fool us! You're just here 'cause you know the treasure of Zachariah Yore's on this planet.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: The treasure is on the same planet as Colin and Stabby Barf Pain? What are the odds?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you're never gonna get to St. Louis before—

Name: Meap
Dialog: Shh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'll stop talking now.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: (chuckles) Set a course for St. Louis!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, Perry the Platypus, I've got an idea.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, first thing's first, we gotta take down these robots that look like us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, they look just like us. That's weird, right? Come on, let's go save Balloony.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello, alien tourists!  Put down that city property and make your way to the dance floor!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Cleaning is fun!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, now you ruined it!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: So where could that treasure be? (gasps) That's it!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Once I get that treasure, I'll use the money to create my own army to destroy the Alliance! Or maybe Earth, first. I don't know the exact order, but there's going to be a lot of destroying. Ready the winch!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Pull!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: The lost treasure case... Well, it's more a valise, but I found—Maybe it's more of a briefca—But it belongs to me!

Name: Alliance Commander
Dialog: This is the Outer Worlds Commando Alliance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, good timing! Guess I leaked the St. Louis info at just the right time.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: What on Earth are you talking about?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You are so busted!

Name: Alliance Commander
Dialog: Hang on, hang on, Mitch, have we literally caught you red handed stealin' the lost treasure of Yore, exactly as Meap warned us you were?

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Well, when you say it like that...

Name: Candace
Dialog: You fell for the oldest trick in the book.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Well, well, well, you—Colin, cover my escape!

Name: Ship's computer
Dialog: Warning

Name: Meap
Dialog: Come on, Candace! He's getting away!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How did you... I'm still... Whah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Balloony, I came to rescue you!

Name: Ship's computer
Dialog: Warning

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, Perry the Platypus, this ship is gonna expl— (notices Perry fighting robots) Oh, oh, never mind. I'm on it. I'm on it. Oh, I guess I just have to press this blue button. Uh, Balloony, what are you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I know that's just the air currents pushing you around, but that's still special! Aaah!

Name: Ship's computer
Dialog: Warning

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Gotta get to that button!

Name: Ship's computer
Dialog: It's a go, people. You should consider leaving. I'm surprised you're still here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Balloony! Okay, clown-bots, let's try fighting to save my friends maniacally!

Name: Ship's computer
Dialog: Self-destruct in 3... 2... 1...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I guess in retrospect, I should've pressed that first.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: I hope he won't mind me borrowing his silly little toy ship.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Ha ha ha ha!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get away from him, you Mitch!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Oh, hilarious. I truly expected to turn and see you pointing some huge atomic neuralizer at me or something, but you've got nothing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not nothing. I have the key fob to that ship so you can't escape.

Name: Mitch
Dialog: I'll take that.

Name: Meap
Dialog: No, Candace! If he hits that red turbo button, he'll be going so fast we'll never be able to catch him!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: See ya! Wouldn't wanna be ya!

Name: Mitch
Dialog: Ha ha ha ha ha!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that worked. "Red turbo button."

Name: Meap
Dialog: I learned from the best. Shall we say it together?

Name: Meap and Candace
Dialog: Busted!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And with my hands actually tied behind my back!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on, Balloony. This is us. I'm just so glad to have you back. But watch yourself, Perry the Platypus! I got maniacal fighting skills now! You saw!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, we're in St. Louis? When did that happen?!

Name: Alliance Commander
Dialog: Listen, listen, I don't think nobody noticed, just put it back.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Meap.

Name: Meap
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #10

Name: Alien 4
Dialog: You know what? It's not as much fun anymore. It just feels like work.

Name: Alliance Commander
Dialog: (giving Meap a medal) You're a true hero and I should've had faith in you. Although, actual evidence really helped.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Thanks, but the real hero here is Candace Flynn. It was her plan to bust Big Mitch that saved that day.

Name: Alliance Commander
Dialog: (giving a medal to Candace) Then I officially make Candace Flynn an unofficial agent of the Alliance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (salutes) Thank you, Chief.

Name: Alliance Commander
Dialog: So what time you coming home tonight, baby?

Name: Meap
Dialog: Oh, I dunno, honey. Six... sevenish?

Name: Alliance Commander
Dialog: (going back to her ship) Okay, cool. Remember that my mama is coming for dinner tonight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, so that's your wife.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Yeah, no one ruthlessly hunts you across the galaxy like my Brenda.

Name: Alliance Commander
Dialog: Hey, you know, we didn't get to enjoy this fifth season, so would you mind if we borrowed your Stabby Barf Pain generator?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not at all! It's all yours!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, oh. And I was just about to call Mom on that.

Name: Meap
Dialog: Thank you, kids, and especially you, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe some good has come out of my busting obsession.

Name: Meap
Dialog: I don't think it's really a busting obsession. It's a justice obsession, and the day that you realize that, well, that just might be the day all your dreams start coming true.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah, it's definitely a busting obsession.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So we're not doing a trailer for the next one?

Name: Narrator
Dialog: And now, a trailer for another episode we do not intend to make!

Name: Narrator
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #11

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wasn't that Suzy stuff supposed to be in this one?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: TRAILER SHOT #12

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, all right. I guess that's a victory.
